evidence.M1: rules.md R-07: "When the second cancel call also gets no answer, it re-reads the order again; if the order is still placed or processing, it sends no third cancel call and hands the case to staff"; model.py resets cancel_reread="" on the second cancel so the re-read is forced.
evidence.M3: rules.md R-09: "Failed or no refund: it hands the case to staff and says the refund is not confirmed yet"; model.py SAYS refund_status_unknown = "the order is cancelled but the refund is not confirmed yet".
evidence.P7: rules.md R-13 and D-02 (owner, accepting the recommendation): "The agent handles one order at a time, each with its own proposal and its own yes"; SC-45 covers a second order named mid-conversation.
evidence.P10: rules.md D-06 (decided by the owner): "A call to list the orders that gets no answer may be sent again with no limit"; interview-log Q14 put the bound to the owner, who answered "Reads may be retried on timeout without limit".
evidence.P21: rules.md table: "the refund call answered a transient error on the second call | creates a follow-up task: refund not issued" and "the refund call answered failed | creates a follow-up task: refund not issued" with no re-read; SC-28 (refund unanswered, second call answers failed, follow-up created) skips the re-read.
evidence.P25: No claim or rule in claims.md or rules.md says how an order number in another case is matched; R-01 says only "an order number that matches none of their orders"; no interview-log question on it.
evidence.P26: rules.md R-04 covers "Any change to the proposal after the yes" and the table has only "the customer said no" and "said yes, then asked for a different refund amount or payment method"; no rule for a yes withdrawn in the same message.
evidence.F2: model.py has "cancel call gets no answer (nothing changed)" and keeps the order open after a re-read until the next cancel, so a late-landing cancel never happens; no claim (C-08, C-37, C-38) states it and no Decisions row or interview question covers it.
evidence.F8: scenarios.md SC-43: "the agent must name no date or number of days" narrows the ban, though rules.md R-11 says "It promises nothing about when the money arrives"; a test from SC-43 would pass a vague promise like "soon".
